Web Services

Web services allow Manager to connect to external data sources for automatic updates. This feature helps keep your financial data current without manual entry.

Currently, web services are primarily used to fetch real-time exchange rates from online sources. This ensures your multi-currency transactions use accurate conversion rates.

To configure a web service, click the New Web Service button and select the type of service you want to set up. Each service will have its own configuration options based on the data it provides.
